source: Meetup city search, round 2 (20 metros in weak-coverage states)
note: Every listing was verified on the group's own Meetup events page: an upcoming event whose title names mahjong, with the day and time taken from the posted dates and cross-checked against Meetup's own series record. Five of the seven have no street address because the organiser publishes none; those must stay city-level.

listings.name: Game Haven Herriman — Mahjong Club
listings.cost: $10 for the 11am beginner lesson; open play from 12pm
listings.description: Weekly American mahjong at Game Haven Herriman, run by the Board Games SLC Meetup group. Open play starts at 12pm. Beginners can arrive at 11am for a $10 personal lesson first, so no prior experience is needed.
listings.howToJoin: Organised through the group's Meetup page.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Salt Lake City, then verified on the group's own events page: 3 upcoming sessions titled "Mahjong Club". Style, times and cost are quoted from the event description, which reads "learn how to play American mahjong" and "meeting at 12pm every Tuesday. To learn how to play, come at 11am and for $10 get personal lessons". Meetup records the series as "Every week on Tuesday until March 30, 2027". The 11:00 AM start is the lesson slot; open play itself begins at noon.

listings.name: Bridge to Dogtown — Bridge & Mahjong
listings.description: Monthly afternoon of bridge and mahjong in Dogtown, on the second Saturday. Enter by the east door, across from the Seamus McDaniel's parking lot. The group has plenty of bridge tables but only one mahjong set, so bring your own set if you have one. Snacks and drinks to share are welcome.
listings.howToJoin: Organised through the group's Meetup page.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of St Louis, then verified on the group's own events page: 2 upcoming sessions titled "Bridge (and Mahjong) to Dogtown!" on 12 Sep and 10 Oct. Meetup records the series as "Every 2nd Saturday of the month until February 14, 2027". Address, entrance and the one-set caveat are quoted from the event description. STYLE NOT STATED by the organiser — recorded as american on the base rate for US social play; confirm before relying on it.

listings.name: West County Singles — Mah Jongg and Dinner
listings.description: Weekly Tuesday afternoon Mah Jongg followed by dinner, run by the West County Singles Meetup group in the Ballwin area. The venue address is shared with members after RSVP rather than published, and the group approves new members before they can join.
listings.howToJoin: Join the West County Singles Meetup group (membership is approved by the organisers) and RSVP to the session. The address is given to attendees on RSVP.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of St Louis, then verified on the group's own events page: 5 upcoming sessions titled "Mah Jongg and Dinner". Meetup records the series as "Every week on Tuesday until December 29, 2026" — re-check after that date. NO ADDRESS ON PURPOSE: every event carries "venue": null with eventType PHYSICAL, so the organiser has chosen not to publish one; city is the group's own registered city. STYLE NOT STATED — recorded as american, which the "Mah Jongg" spelling conventionally indicates, but the group does not say so outright.

listings.name: West County Singles — Mah Jongg Daytime
listings.description: Daytime Mah Jongg on alternate Fridays, run by the West County Singles Meetup group in the Ballwin area. A separate session from the group's Tuesday evening Mah Jongg and Dinner. The venue address is shared with members after RSVP.
listings.howToJoin: Join the West County Singles Meetup group (membership is approved by the organisers) and RSVP to the session. The address is given to attendees on RSVP.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of St Louis, then verified on the group's own events page: 4 upcoming sessions, 12:30-3:30 PM on 4, 18 and 25 Sep and 2 Oct. The event title says "1st, 3rd and 5th Friday" but Meetup's own series record reads "Every 2 weeks on Friday", which is what the dates show — the title is the organiser's approximation, so the frequency here follows the series record. Separated from the group's Tuesday session because it is a different series at a different time; merging them would have put 4:00 PM against every Friday date. NO ADDRESS ON PURPOSE — see the Tuesday listing.

listings.name: Mahjong With Friends — Weekday Evenings
listings.description: Evening mahjong in the Greenbrier area, run by the Mahjong With Friends Meetup group. Sessions are posted individually rather than on a fixed weekday, usually 6-9pm, and seats are capped at eight, so check the group's calendar and RSVP rather than turning up. The address is shared with members after RSVP.
listings.howToJoin: Join the Mahjong With Friends Meetup group (the organiser approves members) and RSVP to a specific evening — places are limited to eight. The address is given to attendees on RSVP.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Nashville, then verified on the group's own events page: 4 upcoming "Mahjong With Friends Weekday Evening Event" sessions, all 6-9 PM, on Mon 31 Aug, Fri 11 Sep, Tue 22 Sep and Tue 29 Sep. NOT A FIXED WEEKLY SLOT: the events carry no Meetup series, so the organiser schedules each one by hand. The days recorded here are the ones actually posted, and the description says so — nobody can arrive on the wrong day in any case, because attendance requires an RSVP and the address is not public. NO ADDRESS ON PURPOSE: every event has "venue": null with eventType PHYSICAL. STYLE NOT STATED — recorded as american on the base rate.

listings.name: Mahjong With Friends — Weekend Session
listings.description: Sunday afternoon mahjong in the Greenbrier area, run by the Mahjong With Friends Meetup group. A longer weekend session, separate from the group's weekday evenings. Seats are limited, so RSVP on the group's calendar; the address is shared with members after RSVP.
listings.howToJoin: Join the Mahjong With Friends Meetup group (the organiser approves members) and RSVP. The address is given to attendees on RSVP.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Nashville. One upcoming "Mahjong With Friends Weekend Event", Sun 27 Sep, 1:30-5:00 PM. Kept separate from the group's weekday listing because it is a different session at a different time. Only one occurrence was posted, so "monthly" is the conservative reading of an unposted cadence, not a stated one — re-check after September. NO ADDRESS ON PURPOSE and STYLE NOT STATED, as for the weekday listing.
